content.introduction: The United States Stock Market Index (US500) traded at 7,687.22 on October 2, 2026, increasing 14.91 or 0.19 percent since the previous trading session, according to Trading Economics. The index rose to 7,673 points on October 1, 2026, gaining 0.28% from the previous session. Over the past month, the index climbed 0.09% and is up 14.27% compared to the same time last year. The sources also provide historical data showing an all-time high of 7,816.70 in August 2026.

## The main stock market index of United States, the US500, rose to 7673 points on October 1, 2026, gaining 0.28% from the previous session. Historically, the United States Stock Market Index reached an all time high of 7816.70 in August of 2026.
